The Growing Demand for EV Chargers in Lawndale and Los Angeles County

The electric vehicle revolution has transformed California's automotive landscape, and Lawndale residents are embracing this change. According to the California Energy Commission, the state surpassed 201,180 fully public and shared EV charging ports by September 2025, representing 68% more EV charger ports than the number of gasoline nozzles statewide. This remarkable milestone demonstrates California's commitment to sustainable transportation, with an estimated 700,000 Level 2 chargers installed in single-family homes across the state.

For Lawndale homeowners, this means that installing a residential EV charger is no longer a luxury but an increasingly common home improvement project. The Los Angeles Department of Water and Power has partnered with the City of Los Angeles Department of Building and Safety to streamline the EV charger permitting approval and inspection process, making it easier than ever to add charging capability to your home. California also offers grants of up to $6,000 per charger, with Los Angeles providing additional rebates on Level 2 chargers, making professional installation more affordable for residents.

Shaffer Construction has been at the forefront of this infrastructure expansion in Lawndale, helping homeowners and businesses navigate the complexities of EV charger installation. Professional EV Charger Installation Services in Lawndale

When it comes to EV charger installation in Lawndale, Shaffer Construction offers comprehensive services tailored to both residential and commercial properties. For homeowners, we typically recommend Level 2 chargers operating at 240 volts, which provide significantly faster charging than standard 120-volt outlets. A Level 2 charger can add 10 to 40 miles of range per hour, allowing most electric vehicles to fully charge overnight. This requires a dedicated 240-volt circuit, similar to what powers electric dryers or ranges, and often necessitates an electrical panel upgrade to ensure adequate capacity.

Our residential EV charger installation process begins with a thorough electrical assessment of your Lawndale home. Many properties in the area were built between the 1950s and 1990s and may have electrical panels rated at 100 to 150 amps. Modern homes with EV chargers, smart home devices, air conditioning, and multiple large appliances typically benefit from 200-amp service. During our initial consultation, Shaffer Construction electricians evaluate your existing electrical infrastructure, calculate your home's total electrical load, and determine whether a panel upgrade is necessary before installing your EV charger.

For commercial property owners in Lawndale, Shaffer Construction provides scalable EV charging solutions ranging from single Level 2 chargers for small businesses to multiple charging stations for apartment complexes, retail centers, and office buildings. Commercial EV charging infrastructure not only serves employee and customer needs but also positions businesses as sustainability leaders in the community. As detailed in our article about planning EV charger infrastructure in Los Angeles, commercial installations require careful consideration of electrical capacity, parking layout, usage patterns, and potential revenue generation through paid charging services.

Shaffer Construction manages all aspects of commercial EV charger installation, including coordination with Los Angeles Department of Building and Safety for permits, electrical design to accommodate multiple charging stations, trenching and conduit installation for parking lot chargers, and integration with existing building management systems. Our expertise ensures your Lawndale commercial property meets all applicable codes while providing reliable charging infrastructure for your tenants, employees, or customers.

Essential Electrical Panel Upgrades for Modern Homes

Electrical panel upgrades represent one of the most critical home improvement projects for Lawndale homeowners, yet they are often overlooked until a problem arises. According to the Los Angeles Municipal Code, all electrical work must comply with the National Electrical Code, California Electrical Code, and local Los Angeles amendments. When conflicts arise between these codes, the Los Angeles Municipal Code prevails, making it essential to work with electricians familiar with local requirements.

Shaffer Construction specializes in electrical panel upgrades for Lawndale homes, addressing common issues such as insufficient amperage, outdated circuit breakers, federal Pacific panels known for safety concerns, and lack of capacity for modern electrical demands. Many Lawndale properties still operate with 100-amp or even 60-amp electrical service, which was adequate decades ago but struggles to support today's electrical loads. Adding an EV charger, which can draw 40 to 50 amps, often pushes these older systems beyond their safe capacity.

Our panel upgrade process follows stringent Los Angeles electrical codes and includes proper grounding systems, GFCI protection for all 125-volt, single-phase, 15 and 20 ampere receptacles in bathrooms, garages, outdoors, crawl spaces, and kitchens, and AFCI protection for all outlets in bedrooms. The Los Angeles County 2023 Electrical Code amendments provide specific requirements for panel installations, and Shaffer Construction stays current with all code updates to ensure your upgrade meets or exceeds these standards.

Upgrading your electrical panel not only provides the capacity needed for EV chargers and modern appliances but also enhances safety by replacing outdated breakers that may fail to trip during overload conditions. Shaffer Construction uses only high-quality electrical panels from trusted manufacturers, installs them in easily accessible locations as required by code, and ensures all work is inspected and approved by the Los Angeles Department of Building and Safety. For Lawndale homeowners considering both a panel upgrade and EV charger installation, our residential EV charger installation services include comprehensive electrical assessments and coordinated upgrades to handle your complete electrical needs efficiently.

Electrical Safety Inspections and Code Compliance

Electrical safety should never be compromised, yet many Lawndale properties operate with electrical systems that no longer meet current safety standards. Shaffer Construction provides comprehensive electrical safety inspections for residential and commercial properties throughout Lawndale, identifying potential hazards such as overloaded circuits, improper grounding, outdated wiring, lack of GFCI or AFCI protection, and deteriorated electrical components. Our licensed electricians conduct thorough evaluations using advanced testing equipment to assess the condition and safety of your entire electrical system.

Los Angeles electrical codes have evolved significantly over the past few decades, incorporating new safety technologies and addressing emerging hazards. Ground Fault Circuit Interrupter protection, now required in bathrooms, kitchens, garages, outdoor areas, and other locations where water and electricity may come into contact, can prevent electrocution by immediately cutting power when a ground fault is detected. Arc Fault Circuit Interrupter protection, mandatory for bedroom outlets, detects dangerous electrical arcing that can cause fires and shuts off the circuit before ignition occurs. Many older Lawndale homes lack these critical safety features, leaving residents vulnerable to electrical hazards.

Shaffer Construction's electrical safety inspections go beyond simple visual assessments. We test circuit breakers for proper operation, verify grounding systems meet current standards, measure electrical loads on individual circuits and the main panel, inspect wiring for damage or improper installations, and identify any work performed without proper permits. Following our inspection, we provide a detailed report outlining any safety concerns and recommended repairs or upgrades, prioritized by urgency and importance.

For property owners preparing for real estate transactions, our electrical safety inspections can identify issues before they become deal-breakers during buyer inspections. For landlords, regular electrical inspections help ensure tenant safety and reduce liability. As discussed in our article about preparing Los Angeles buildings for the EV charging boom, proactive electrical assessments are essential for property owners planning future improvements or expansions that will increase electrical demands.
